instructions: In the coding window, try to indent the print() statement using 4 spaces so that the program runs without an error. If you remove the indentation, you should see an IndentationError.
starterCode:
if 1 == 1:
print("I need to be indented!")
solution:
if 1 == 1:
    print("I need to be indented!")
hints: Python requires consistent indentation for code blocks
Use exactly 4 spaces for each level of indentation
The print statement should be indented under the if statement
